rendered: The TGA-DTG curves in Fig. 4[1] show weight loss from an organic coating layer and from carbon black (CB) on the recovered NMC622. The organic coating layer loses ~3.3 wt% loss at ~350 °C[2], and CB loses ~4.1 wt% loss at ~550 °C[3]. Calcination removes both: the text says they can be both removed by calcining in air[4] at 600 °C[5]. The authors describe the organic layer as a possible product of a reaction between NMC622 and Cyrene that is under further investigation[6].
